title: The table slam (Magnus Carlsen vs Gukesh, 2025)
post: He slammed the table, then called the champion 'presumably weaker' 😳 #chess #magnuscarlsen #gukesh #story

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: Magnus Carlsen lost to the world champion and slammed the table so hard pieces hit the floor.
phrases.say: [mischievously] Magnus Carlsen lost to the world champion... and slammed the table so hard, pieces hit the floor.

phrases.text: A month later, he called that champion 'presumably weaker.' Big mistake.
phrases.say: [curious] A month later, he called that champion... 'presumably weaker.' [serious] Big mistake.

phrases.text: Gukesh, nineteen, world champion. Magnus, number one.
phrases.say: Gukesh, nineteen, world champion. Magnus, number one.

phrases.text: Norway. Magnus is clearly winning, then his clock drops under a minute, and he blunders a knight.
phrases.say: Norway. Magnus is clearly winning... then his clock drops under a minute... [whispers] and he blunders a knight.

phrases.text: Gukesh's knight runs back just in time. Magnus resigns, and...
phrases.say: [excited] Gukesh's knight runs back... just in time! Magnus resigns... and...

phrases.text: He apologizes, pats Gukesh on the back, and walks out.
phrases.say: He apologizes... pats Gukesh on the back... and walks out.

phrases.text: Gukesh's reaction? 'I have also banged a lot of tables in my career.'
phrases.say: [mischievously] Gukesh's reaction? 'I have also banged a lot of tables in my career.'

phrases.text: And Kasparov posted: 'We'll buy extra-heavy tables!'
phrases.say: [mischievously] And Kasparov posted... 'We'll buy extra-heavy tables!'

phrases.text: Their next game: Zagreb. Gukesh is losing again,
phrases.say: Their next game, Zagreb. Gukesh is losing again...

phrases.text: then Magnus plays b4. Kasparov: 'You don't play b4, period!'
phrases.say: then Magnus plays B-four. [excited] Kasparov... 'You don't play B-four, period!'

phrases.text: Gukesh strikes back. Magnus resigns again.
phrases.say: [excited] Gukesh strikes back... Magnus resigns again.

phrases.text: No slam this time. He silently sets the pieces back up, and leaves.
phrases.say: [softly] No slam this time. He silently sets the pieces back up... and leaves.

phrases.text: Kasparov: 'Now we can question Magnus' domination.'
phrases.say: [serious] Kasparov... 'Now we can question Magnus' domination.'

phrases.text: Now Magnus predicts Gukesh will lose his title match.
phrases.say: [mischievously] Now... Magnus predicts Gukesh will lose his title match.

phrases.text: So, one to ten: how weak is the world champion?
phrases.say: [curious] So... one to ten. How weak is the world champion?
